tooling_readiness.credential_evidence: Read-only Get-R2Inventory.ps1 succeeded; all six uploader -WhatIf probes reached guarded upload stop without credential or R2-access failure. No secret value recorded.
tooling_readiness.overwrite_guard: Uploader calls R2 head-object and refuses an existing key before s3 cp; fresh pre-upload live listing and per-key guard are both required.

execution_after_authorization.authorization_required: Explicit owner authorization for six unchanged-original uploads, including the 150,000,000-byte MaxObjectBytes override for three files.
execution_after_authorization.shell: Windows PowerShell with -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass, from repository root
execution_after_authorization.public_byte_verification_method: Test-R2PublicObject.ps1 performs public GET from each files.abqinfo.com URL and compares exact local/public size and SHA-256. Compare its result to this manifest for each record.
execution_after_authorization.post_upload_accounting: Refresh read-only live R2 inventory; require six new keys, 1,237 total objects, 9,218,281,842 total bytes, and unchanged pre-existing keys/size/ETag. Reconcile saved R2 inventory and candidate r2_key/r2_url/status only after exact public-byte verification.
execution_after_authorization.abort_rule: Stop on any changed staged bytes, key collision, upload error, public-byte mismatch, or R2 accounting discrepancy; do not overwrite.
